Établir, maintenir et approfondir des relations solides et de la crédibilité avec les collègues, les clients et les intermédiaires en étant accessibles et proactifs dans le partage des connaissances. Encourager le travail en équipe, la collaboration et une culture de travail positive. Développement des entreprises
- Favoriser et soutenir la croissance des entreprises par l'élaboration de nouveaux plans stratégiques d'affaires et travailler avec des collègues afin d'attirer des occasions et de nouvelles entreprises provenant de groupes plus larges, d'introductions externes et de clients potentiels, avec l'appui de voyages vers des clients et des intermédiaires au besoin. Agir comme l'un des principaux points de contact pour les nouvelles demandes de renseignements commerciaux, y compris la supervision des nouvelles propositions d'affaires et la documentation d'emplacement pour les clients éventuels et/ou les intermédiaires avec l'équipe de direction.
- Favoriser l'atteinte du budget de la Division et de nouveaux objectifs opérationnels par l'intégration proactive de nouvelles relations avec les clients et la gestion et le développement continus des relations avec les clients.
- Maintenir une sensibilisation aux capacités de service de l'entreprise et de la division et créer des alliances stratégiques avec des tiers. Être un modèle et un ambassadeur pour l'EFG à la fois à l'interne et à l'externe, assister à des conférences, des événements de réseautage et d'autres occasions pertinentes.
- Maintenir une connaissance de l'environnement commercial externe et des tendances pertinentes propres à l'industrie, tant au niveau local que dans d'autres administrations où nous sommes exposés, de manière à ce que la gamme de services offerts aux clients soit constamment revue et à ce que des conseils judicieux et pratiques soient fournis aux collègues et aux clients. Finances
- Pour faire avancer le changement dans l'ensemble de la Division, qui peut être directement lié à une rentabilité accrue. Élaborer des économies en introduisant de nouvelles procédures, de nouveaux systèmes, de nouvelles pratiques de travail, une meilleure gestion financière et d'autres initiatives.
- Diriger les examens commerciaux de secteurs particuliers de la Division et fournir des examens des constatations et des plans d'action proposés au CEO EFGIJ.
- Apporter des contributions aux budgets de la Division et veiller à ce que les résultats financiers soient surveillés et constamment comparés aux objectifs et aux activités, afin de s'assurer que les objectifs sont atteints. Fonctionnement
- Participer, contribuer de façon constructive et présider des comités/réunions internes, au besoin, et veiller à ce que les renseignements clés soient présentés en temps opportun et avec exactitude, le cas échéant. Agir à titre d'administrateur ou de fiduciaire des entités clientes au besoin.
- Agir comme point de contact pour les équipes administratives, opérationnelles et comptables sur les questions techniques et autres au sein de la Division. Démontrer une excellente connaissance des exigences en matière de gouvernance d'entreprise, de conformité interne, de lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent et d'autres politiques et procédures pertinentes.
- Promouvoir les normes les plus élevées en matière d'administration des services à la clientèle et de services fiduciaires, en veillant à ce que la surveillance appropriée soit maintenue, ce qui permettra de gérer et de contrôler efficacement les risques fiduciaires et opérationnels.
- Collaborer avec l'équipe de la haute direction pour déterminer les domaines dans lesquels on peut améliorer l'expérience des clients et réaliser des économies opérationnelles, en veillant à ce que la Division fonctionne de façon efficiente et efficace. Contribuer et maintenir des politiques et des procédures adéquates pour les travaux menés par la Division, en veillant à ce qu'elles soient conformes aux normes de documentation attendues du GEF.
- Surveillez le ressourcement, la rétention et le développement de votre fonction/équipe.
- Agir en tant que Signataire autorisé
- Prendre en charge son propre développement personnel, conformément aux objectifs de performance annuels convenus. Conformité et risques
- Contribuer à la mise en oeuvre de cadres efficaces de gestion des risques et superviser leur mise en oeuvre.
- S'assurer que les clients sont administrés conformément au cadre de gestion des risques de l'EFG, que les risques liés à la structure et les risques fiduciaires sont atténués au besoin. Se conformer à toutes les exigences réglementaires locales, y compris, le cas échéant, les lois, les ordonnances, les codes de pratique et d'orientation, les politiques et procédures de groupe et locales pertinentes pour l'entreprise.
- S'assurer que toutes les exigences de la DPC sont satisfaites année après année pour vous et tous les membres de votre équipe, et que la formation et le perfectionnement sont pertinents. Qualifications, compétences et expérience
- Qualification professionnelle reconnue - p.ex. comptabilité, secrétaire agréé, STEP, banque, valeurs mobilières, conformité ou autre qualification pertinente du tableau 4 ainsi que l'expérience pertinente telle que définie par la Commission des services financiers de Jersey - 8 années d'expérience pertinente dans le secteur financier travaillant au sein d'une organisation de services financiers offshore dans un rôle similaire, avec une bonne compréhension technique de tous les domaines de l'administration des clients et des services fiduciaires.
- Se concentrer sur le développement, la maintenance et la croissance de l'activité [Division/Fonction], assurer des niveaux de qualité de service à la clientèle, la cohérence et l'efficacité opérationnelle. Capacité de gérer la complexité et de diriger des initiatives à grande échelle.
- Compréhension complète et détaillée du droit des sociétés, de la législation actuelle de l'industrie, de la réglementation et des pratiques de travail, compte dûment tenu des aspects liés à la gouvernance d'entreprise, à la conformité et à la gestion des risques.
- Une bonne compréhension de la gestion financière de l'entreprise.
- Expérience de la gestion et du leadership des personnes, conduisant une culture de haute performance. Capacité de communiquer avec d'autres secteurs de l'entreprise et avec les intervenants clés de façon fiable et professionnelle.
- Un leadership et des aptitudes interpersonnelles solides, accessibles et accessibles, capables d'inspirer, de motiver et de développer les autres, et de gérer la sous-performance rapidement et équitablement.
- Compétence dans l'utilisation d'une gamme de produits Microsoft (Outlook, Word, Excel et PowerPoint). Nos valeurs
- Responsabilisation : prise en charge des tâches et des défis, et recherche d'une amélioration continue
- Pratique : être proactif pour obtenir rapidement des résultats de grande qualité
- Passionné : être engagé et viser l'excellence
- Inspiré par la solution : se concentrer sur les résultats des clients et traiter les clients avec équité et sensibilisation aux risques
- Objectif du partenariat : promouvoir la collaboration et le travail d'équipe. Travailler ensemble avec un esprit d'entreprise.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Main Responsibilities

- Perform your role in accordance with procedures, under supervision and direction of a line manager.

- Build a thorough understanding of the activities within your remit and ensure that all necessary activities and actions are organised and undertaken in a timely, diligent and accurate manner.

- Assess the adequacy and accuracy of due diligence (CDD/KYC) documentation and ensure compliance with the Jersey Financial Services Commission (JFSC) requirements.

- Identify, document and escalate deficiencies, risks, or compliance concerns.

- Ensure the records are accurate, up-to-date, and properly maintained in accordance with internal policies and local regulations.

- Assist in the development and enhancement of the review methodologies, procedures, and reporting standards.

- Process CDD/KYC checks on new leads/prospects as required, input and update of data in respect of such leads/prospects for both reporting and onboarding purposes.

- Assist with the update and processing of onboarding materials in liaison with the relevant client administration team.

- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant laws and regulations, and industry practices affecting trust and company business in Jersey.

- Contribute to achievement of the Division's generic objectives.

- Contribute to operational projects and system enhancements, including UAT testing, process automation, and data quality initiatives.

- Contribute to the team’s performance and suggest changes that enhance service levels and efficiencies.

- Willingness to contribute outside the scope of your role to support colleagues and the business.

- Take responsibility for own personal development, in line with agreed annual performance objectives.

## Skills and experience

- A good academic background, to include GCSE or equivalent in English and Mathematics at Grade C (level 4) or above.    Desire to study towards a relevant professional qualification.   Willingness to learn the local finance industry, legislation and regulatory requirements in the environment in which we operate.

- At least 1 years’ administration experience.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively with stakeholders across the business.    Good organisation and interpersonal skills.

- Possess a strong commitment to client service excellence.    Ability to work independently, take responsibility and be proactive.

- Ability to multi-task and deliver within agreed timeframes, whilst remaining calm under pressure.

- Good use of a range of Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint).   Knowledge of Navision would be desirable.

- Support is provided for relevant professional qualifications including Corporate Governance Institute certificates and diploma.

## Our Values

-  Accountability : Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

-  Hands-on : Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

-  Passionate : Being committed and striving for excellence

-  Solution-driven : Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

-  Partnership-oriented : Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit
descriptionByLocale.it:
Responsabilità Principali
- Esegui il tuo ruolo in conformità con le procedure, sotto la supervisione e la direzione di un direttore di linea.
- Costruire una comprensione approfondita delle attività all'interno del vostro mandato e garantire che tutte le attività e le azioni necessarie siano organizzate e intraprese in modo tempestivo, diligente e accurato.
- Valutare l'adeguatezza e l'accuratezza della documentazione di due diligence (CDD/KYC) e garantire il rispetto dei requisiti della Jersey Financial Services Commission (JFSC).
- Identificare, documentare e aumentare le carenze, i rischi o le preoccupazioni di conformità.
- Assicurarsi che i record siano precisi, aggiornati e adeguatamente mantenuti in conformità alle politiche interne e alle normative locali.
- Assistere nello sviluppo e nella valorizzazione delle metodologie di revisione, procedure e standard di reporting.
- Elaborare controlli CDD/KYC su nuovi lead/prospects come richiesto, input e aggiornamento dei dati in relazione a tali lead/prospettive sia a fini di reporting che di onboarding.
- Assistere con l'aggiornamento e l'elaborazione dei materiali di bordo in collegamento con il relativo team di amministrazione client.
- Mantenere la conoscenza aggiornata di leggi e regolamenti pertinenti, e le pratiche del settore che interessano la fiducia e il business aziendale in Jersey.
- Contribuire al raggiungimento degli obiettivi generici della Divisione.
- Contribuire a progetti operativi e miglioramenti del sistema, tra cui test UAT, processi di automazione e iniziative di qualità dei dati.
- Contribuisci alle prestazioni del team e suggerisci modifiche che migliorano i livelli di servizio e le efficienze.
- Volontà di contribuire al di fuori della portata del vostro ruolo per sostenere i colleghi e il business.
- No. Prendere la responsabilità per il proprio sviluppo personale, in linea con gli obiettivi annuali di prestazione concordati.

## Abilità ed esperienza
- Un buon background accademico, per includere GCSE o equivalente in inglese e matematica al grado C (livello 4) o superiore. Desideri studiare per una qualifica professionale rilevante. La volontà di apprendere l'industria finanziaria locale, la legislazione e i requisiti normativi nell'ambiente in cui operiamo.
- No. Almeno 1 anni di esperienza amministrativa.
- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione con la capacità di lavorare in collaborazione con gli stakeholder di tutto il business. Buona organizzazione e competenze interpersonali.
- Possede un forte impegno per l'eccellenza del servizio clienti. Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, prendere la responsabilità e essere proattivo.
- Capacità di multi-task e consegnare entro i tempi concordati, pur rimanendo calma sotto pressione.
- Buon uso di una gamma di prodotti Microsoft (Outlook, Word, Excel e PowerPoint). La conoscenza di Navision sarebbe auspicabile.
- Il supporto è fornito per le qualifiche professionali rilevanti, tra cui i certificati e il diploma dell'istituto di governo aziendale.

## Our Values
- Accountability: Assumere la proprietà per i compiti e le sfide, nonché cercare un miglioramento continuo
- Hands-on: Essere proattivi a fornire rapidamente risultati di alta qualità
- Passionate: Essere impegnati e impegnati per l'eccellenza
- Solution-driven: Focusing sui risultati del cliente e trattare i clienti abbastanza con una mentalità di rischio-aware
- Partnership-oriented: Promuovere la collaborazione e il lavoro di squadra. Lavorare insieme a uno spirito imprenditoriale

- Tragen Sie auf die Leistung des Teams bei und schlagen Sie Änderungen vor, die die Service-Level und Effizienz steigern.

- Ein guter akademischer Hintergrund, um GCSE oder gleichwertig in Englisch und Mathematik bei Grade C (Ebene 4) oder oben. Beabsichtigen Sie, eine relevante berufliche Qualifikation zu studieren. Bereitschaft, die lokale Finanzindustrie, Rechtsvorschriften und regulatorische Anforderungen in der Umwelt zu lernen, in der wir tätig sind.
- Ja. Mindestens 1 Jahre Verwaltungserfahrung.
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, gemeinsam mit Interessenvertretern im gesamten Unternehmen zu arbeiten. Gute Organisation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten.
- Ein starkes Engagement für den Kundendienst. Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und proaktiv zu sein.
- Fähigkeit, innerhalb von vereinbarten Zeiträumen zu multi-Task und zu liefern, während ruhig unter Druck bleiben.
- Gute Nutzung einer Reihe von Microsoft-Produkten (Outlook, Word, Excel und PowerPoint). Wissen über Navision wäre wünschenswert.
- Unterstützung für relevante Berufsqualifikationen, einschließlich Zertifikate des Corporate Governance Institute und Diplom. Unsere Werte
- Rechenschaftspflicht : Eigentumsbesitz für Aufgaben und Herausforderungen zu nehmen, sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu suchen
- Hands-on : Being proaktiv, um schnell qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu liefern
- Passionate: Engagement und Streben nach Exzellenz
- Lösungsgetrieben : Fokussieren auf Kundenergebnisse und Behandlung von Kunden mit einem risikobewussten Mindset
- Partnerschaftsorientierte: Förderung der Zusammenarbeit und Teamarbeit. Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmergeist

- Oui. Au moins 1 ans d'expérience en administration.
- Excellentes compétences en communication avec la capacité de travailler en collaboration avec les intervenants de l'ensemble de l'entreprise. Bonne organisation et compétences interpersonnelles.
- Possède un engagement ferme envers l'excellence du service à la clientèle. Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante, de prendre des responsabilités et d'être proactif.
- Capacité de faire plusieurs tâches et d'exécuter les tâches dans les délais convenus, tout en restant calme sous pression.

- Responsabilité : S'approprier les tâches et les défis, ainsi que chercher une amélioration continue

- Passionné : S'engager et s'efforcer d'atteindre l'excellence
- Inspiré par la solution : Se concentrer sur les résultats des clients et traiter les clients équitablement avec un état d'esprit conscient des risques
- Orienté par le partenariat : Promouvoir la collaboration et le travail d'équipe. Travailler ensemble avec un esprit d'entreprise

descriptionByLocale.en:
## General Info

- Department: Private Markets

- Work time Percentage: 100%

- Location: Singapore

## Job Description

We are searching for a Senior Private Markets Product Specialist to help drive innovation across the region, as part of our global network.

This is your chance to join an entrepreneurial team, make your mark, and help build the future of private markets in Asia. Be a key player in a newly created position, with real opportunities for personal and professional growth.

We are searching for a candidate who shares our enthusiasm for delivering a first-class client experience through an engaging and proactive relationship approach. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing, seasoned and entrepreneurial team with strong personal and professional development opportunities.

## Main responsibilities

- Accountable for driving a strategic and hands-on distribution effort across our private markets solutions, focusing on EFG’s in-house private markets program and product suite of perpetual/evergreen funds

- Partner with Client Relationship Officers (CROs), Investment Counsellors (ICs) and their clients to increase overall allocations to the asset class

- Responsible for impactful and tailor-made marketing content for in-person and written presentations, both internally and for our global client base

- Foster the ongoing development of our private markets franchise by identifying client demands and trends to shape our future product offering

- Design educational initiatives to drive asset class-specific learning excellence and impact across various stakeholder groups within EFG

## Skills and experience

- 5+ years working experience in distribution and/or sales within the private markets industry, preferably focused on global private wealth clients

- For senior-level role: 10+ years of relevant working experience required

- Ambitious and self-motivation personality with the ability to work in a target driven high-performance culture while maintaining “down-to-earth” attitude

- Entrepreneurial mindset with an enthusiastic, flexible and hands-on approach

- Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in English and Mandarin (Cantonese beneficial)

- Master’s degree in Finance or similar and further professional qualifications (CFA, CAIA, etc.)

- Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to create impactful client-facing marketing material

## Our Values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

## Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

## Application

Should you wish to apply for this position use this link to apply.

## Job Description

This is your chance to join an entrepreneurial team, make your mark, and help build the future of private markets in Asia. Be a key player in a newly created position, with real opportunities for personal and professional growth.

We are searching for a candidate who shares our enthusiasm for delivering a first-class client experience through an engaging and proactive relationship approach. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing, seasoned and entrepreneurial team with strong personal and professional development opportunities.

## Main responsibilities

- Accountable for driving a strategic and hands-on distribution effort across our private markets solutions, focusing on EFG’s in-house private markets program and product suite of perpetual/evergreen funds

- Partner with Client Relationship Officers (CROs), Investment Counsellors (ICs) and their clients to increase overall allocations to the asset class

- Responsible for impactful and tailor-made marketing content for in-person and written presentations, both internally and for our global client base

- Foster the ongoing development of our private markets franchise by identifying client demands and trends to shape our future product offering

- Design educational initiatives to drive asset class-specific learning excellence and impact across various stakeholder groups within EFG

## Skills and experience

- 5+ years working experience in distribution and/or sales within the private markets industry, preferably focused on global private wealth clients

- For senior-level role: 10+ years of relevant working experience required

- Ambitious and self-motivation personality with the ability to work in a target driven high-performance culture while maintaining “down-to-earth” attitude

- Entrepreneurial mindset with an enthusiastic, flexible and hands-on approach

- Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in English and Mandarin (Cantonese beneficial)

- Master’s degree in Finance or similar and further professional qualifications (CFA, CAIA, etc.)

- Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to create impactful client-facing marketing material

## Our Values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

## Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

## Application

Should you wish to apply for this position use this link to apply.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## 1. Risk & Control Management

- Design, implement, perform and oversee the execution of the FLoD control framework for Private Banking, in line with the Group’s risk and control blueprint.

- Perform and supervise ex-post controls with a strong focus on operational processes, regulatory requirements, and conduct risk.

- Ensure timely identification, assessment, escalation, and remediation of operational alerts, control deficiencies, and risk incidents.

- Challenge business practices and processes to enhance risk awareness and control effectiveness.

- Lead or contribute to ad-hoc reviews and deep dives on high-risk topics or emerging risks.

## 2. Risk Assessment & Governance

- Lead Private Banking risk assessments in close coordination with the Second Line of Defence.

- Ensure accurate identification, documentation, and monitoring of key risks, controls, and mitigating actions.

- Act as a key point of contact for internal and external audits, regulatory reviews, and control-related inquiries.

- Support the PB COO and senior management in understanding the risk profile and control environment of the PB activities.

## 3. Reporting & Monitoring

- Oversee and validate daily, monthly, and quarterly control reporting, ensuring high-quality, consistent, and meaningful outputs.

- Prepare and present risk reporting to senior management, including internal control assessments, emerging risks, and remediation progress.

- Contribute to the production of CRO Risk Scorecards and other senior management risk dashboards.

- Ensure appropriate follow-up on issues, action plans, and audit recommendations.

## 4. Advisory & Continuous Improvement

- Act as a trusted advisor to the business on risk management, internal controls, and regulatory expectations.

- Support the enhancement of risk management processes, tools, and methodologies within the FLoD.

Skills and experience

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.

- Minimum 7 years of experience in business risk management, internal controls, or conduct/operational risk within banking or financial services, ideally in Private Banking or Wealth Management.

- Strong understanding of non-financial risks, internal control frameworks, and regulatory requirements applicable to Private Banking.

- Proven experience working within or alongside the First Line of Defence, with strong interaction with 2nd and 3rd LoD functions.

- Ability to operate independently, prioritize effectively, and manage complex risk topics.

- Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to challenge constructively at senior management level.

- Advanced analytical and reporting skills; advanced Excel skills required (additional data or risk tools considered an asset).

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (French and/or German considered an asset).

Our Values

Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

- Assicurare l'identificazione tempestiva, la valutazione, l'escalation e la bonifica degli avvisi operativi, le carenze di controllo e gli incidenti di rischio.
- Sfida le pratiche e i processi aziendali per migliorare la consapevolezza del rischio e controllare l'efficacia.
- Condurre o contribuire a recensioni ad-hoc e immersioni profonde su argomenti ad alto rischio o rischi emergenti.

## 2. Valutazione del rischio & Governance
- Lead Private Banking risk assessment in stretto coordinamento con la seconda linea di difesa.
- Assicurare l'identificazione accurata, la documentazione e il monitoraggio dei rischi, dei controlli e delle azioni di mitigazione.
- Agire come punto chiave di contatto per audit interni ed esterni, revisioni normative e indagini relative al controllo.
- Sostenere il PB COO e la gestione senior nella comprensione del profilo di rischio e dell'ambiente di controllo delle attività PB.

## 3. Reporting & Monitoring
- Controllare e convalidare la reportistica quotidiana, mensile e trimestrale, garantendo uscite di alta qualità, coerenti e significative.
- Preparare e presentare la segnalazione dei rischi alla gestione senior, comprese le valutazioni di controllo interno, i rischi emergenti e i progressi di bonifica.
- Contribuire alla produzione di CRO Risk Scorecards e altre dashboard di rischio senior management.
- Assicurare un adeguato follow-up su questioni, piani d'azione e raccomandazioni di audit.

## 4. Advisory & Continuous Improvement
- Atto come consulente affidabile per l'azienda sulla gestione del rischio, controlli interni e aspettative di regolamentazione.
- Supporta la valorizzazione dei processi di gestione del rischio, degli strumenti e delle metodologie all'interno del FLoD. Competenze ed esperienza
- Laurea o Master in Economia, Business Administration, Finanza o un campo relativo.
- Minimo 7 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei rischi aziendali, nei controlli interni o nel rischio di condurre/operativo all'interno di servizi bancari o finanziari, idealmente in Private Banking o Wealth Management.
- Forte comprensione dei rischi non finanziari, dei quadri di controllo interno e dei requisiti normativi applicabili al Private Banking.
- Provata esperienza di lavoro all'interno o al fianco della First Line of Defence, con una forte interazione con le funzioni 2nd e 3rd LoD.
- Capacità di operare in modo indipendente, priorità in modo efficace, e gestire argomenti di rischio complessi.
- Forte capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di sfidare costruttivamente a livello di gestione senior.
- Avanzate abilità analitiche e di reporting; competenze avanzate di Excel richieste (dati aggiuntivi o strumenti di rischio considerati un bene).
- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese (francese e/o tedesco considerato un bene). Lavorare insieme a uno spirito imprenditoriale.

Zusammenarbeit mit einem Unternehmergeist.

1. Gestion des risques et du contrôle
- Concevoir, mettre en œuvre, exécuter et superviser l'exécution du cadre de contrôle FLoD pour la banque privée, conformément au plan de risque et de contrôle du Groupe.
- Effectuer et superviser les contrôles ex post en mettant fortement l'accent sur les processus opérationnels, les exigences réglementaires et les risques.
- Assurer l'identification, l'évaluation, l'escalade et l'assainissement en temps opportun des alertes opérationnelles, des lacunes de contrôle et des incidents à risque.
- Définer les pratiques et les processus opérationnels pour accroître la sensibilisation aux risques et l'efficacité du contrôle.
- Diriger ou contribuer à des examens ad hoc et à des plongées profondes sur des sujets à haut risque ou des risques émergents. 2. Évaluation et gouvernance des risques
- Diriger les évaluations des risques des banques privées en étroite coordination avec la deuxième ligne de défense.
- Veiller à l'identification, à la documentation et au suivi exacts des principaux risques, contrôles et mesures d'atténuation.
- Agir comme point de contact principal pour les vérifications internes et externes, les examens réglementaires et les demandes de renseignements liées au contrôle.
- Aider le chef de la direction et la haute direction à comprendre le profil de risque et l'environnement de contrôle des activités du chef de la direction. 3. Rapports et surveillance
- Surveiller et valider les rapports de contrôle quotidiens, mensuels et trimestriels, en assurant des extrants de qualité, cohérents et significatifs.
- Préparer et présenter des rapports sur les risques à la haute direction, y compris des évaluations des contrôles internes, des risques émergents et des progrès en matière d'assainissement.
- Contribuer à la production de cartes de pointage des risques des ORC et d'autres tableaux de bord des risques de la haute direction.
- Assurer un suivi approprié des questions, des plans d'action et des recommandations de vérification. 4. Avis et amélioration continue
- Agir en tant que conseiller fiable de l'entreprise sur la gestion des risques, les contrôles internes et les attentes réglementaires.
- Appuyer l'amélioration des processus, des outils et des méthodologies de gestion des risques au sein du FLoD. Compétences et expérience
- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en économie, administration des affaires, finances ou un domaine connexe.
- Au moins 7 ans d'expérience dans la gestion des risques d'entreprise, les contrôles internes ou les risques opérationnels au sein des services bancaires ou financiers, idéalement dans la banque privée ou la gestion de patrimoine.
- Une bonne compréhension des risques non financiers, des cadres de contrôle interne et des exigences réglementaires applicables aux services bancaires privés.
- Expérience éprouvée de travail à l'intérieur ou à côté de la première ligne de défense, avec une forte interaction avec les fonctions 2e et 3e LoD.
- Capacité de fonctionner de façon indépendante, de prioriser efficacement et de gérer des sujets de risque complexes.
- Fortes compétences en gestion des intervenants, avec la capacité de défier de manière constructive au niveau de la haute direction.
- Compétences avancées en matière d ' analyse et d ' établissement de rapports; compétences avancées en matière d ' Excel (données supplémentaires ou outils de gestion des risques considérés comme un atout).
- Excellente capacité de communication écrite et verbale en anglais (français et/ou allemand considéré comme un atout). Nos valeurs Responsabilité : s'approprier les tâches et les défis, et chercher une amélioration continue Mains sur la main : être proactif pour produire rapidement des résultats de haute qualité Passionné : être engagé et viser l'excellence Inspiré par la solution : se concentrer sur les résultats des clients et traiter les clients avec équité avec un état d'esprit conscient des risques. Travailler ensemble avec un esprit d'entreprise.

## Responsibilities

•    Responsible for structured note and derivatives trade processing.

 •    Liaise with sales team and traders on derivatives trade booking issue.

 •    Handle life-cycle events.

 •    Work with head office on security setup and maintain the market price update.

 •    Maintain proper transaction records.

 •    Perform daily reconciliation on traders’ blotters against the system records and broker trade confirmations.

 •    Handle market data administration.

 •    Review and investigate on any unmatched entries in both cash and securities reconciliation reports.

 •    Liaise with traders, brokers, and custodians to resolve any settlement issues or discrepancies.

 •    Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and internal policies.

 •    Handle ad-hoc projects as required.

 •    Perform day-end control

 •    Handle enquires from internal/external parties.

## Requirements

- Bachelor's degree or above

- Strong commitment and able to operate in a dynamic working environment where Communication and teamwork skills are essential

- Good interpersonal skills and ability to work under pressure.

- 5+ years of working experience in banking or financial institutional, preferably in securities settlement

Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

Job Description

In the framework of the First Line of Defense (FLoD), Business Risk Management (BRM) ensures the effectiveness of the Internal Control System in the PB area. Under the supervision of the PB COO, BRM organizes and performs a certain number of tasks around the daily support & monitoring activities of the department. She/He coordinates the PB risk assessment in close alignment with Private Banking Support to achieve a robust FloD.

BRM focuses on ex-post controls, supports the Global BRM in the coordination of FLoD risk management activities, improves the quality of FLoD activity by ensuring that rules and processes are adhered to effectively, supports local CROs with the execution of their controls and acts as interface between the Business Head and 2nd and 3rd LoD functions.

1. Controlling

- Advanced Excel skills

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Main Duties

- Accountable for the development of a comprehensive risk and control assessment for all aspects of risk within the FLoD, including the effective oversight of the testing programme, and review this with the business on a regular basis.

-
Responsible for ensuring that a comprehensive risk based control monitoring programme exists across the function, evidencing the adequacy and effectiveness of key controls

-
Perform regular business controls and monitoring on various areas, i.e. Investment Suitability, Cross Border, Anti-Fraud, etc., and produce management reporting on the findings.

-
Conduct thematic reviews, investigations and gap analysis on different aspects within the FLoD.

-
Participate in ad-hoc projects and work closely with stakeholders to implement changes & enhancements.

-
Responsible for the development of a strong risk awareness and client fairness culture across all aspects of the business.

-
Collaborate with internal stakeholders (i.e. Second Line of Defense (SLoD), Global Function) to identify, assess, and mitigate risks across business operations, and to ensure appropriate controls are in place.

-
Accountable for proactive escalation, reporting, provision of advice and challenging existing processes in relation to the business activities.

- Undertakes any other duties within the Business Risk Management or as directed by the Head of Business Risk Management.

- Manages FLOD Risk Scorecard and ensures proper tracking, execution and integrity of the score card.

- Provides counsel to front office staff on investment advisory activities and to ensure compliance with in-house policies & procedures and local regulatory requirements.

- Builds strong relationships and credibility with key internal stakeholders

## Requirements

- Bachelor degree or above in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or related fields

- 6 years or above of experience in financial or banking industries

- Prior experience with general risk management, including control framework is preferred

- Understanding of products and Wealth regulatory banking environment

- Experienced in liaising with internal business partners

- Demonstrated ability to work with minimal supervision, multi-tasking and to prioritize tasks

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Application

- Should you wish to apply for this position use this link to apply

## Main Duties & Responsibilities

- Introduces the Bank and its banking services to prospective clients.

- Provides support to Relationship Manager to achieve their business goals such as NNA / Revenue targets.

- Markets and provides comprehensive private banking services to meet varied wealth management needs.

- Performs KYC / AML due diligence on clients in compliance with the Bank’s general directive and ongoing periodic review from time to time.

- Go through the Investment Risk Profile Questionnaire with clients at time of account opening as well as ongoing periodic review to ensure and update clients’ investment product suitability, risk tolerance and investment experience from time to time.

- Liaises and coordinates with the Bank’s investment units, e.g. Treasury Department and Global Product Unit for passing on product information and markets commentary to clients from time to time.

- Closely monitor clients’ portfolio and account activities to ensure the compliance with internal guidelines as well as external regulations from time to time. Monitor clients’ position to ensure collateral sufficiency at all times and prompt regularization of excesses, if any.

- Prepares and maintains proper records including but not limited to account documentation, CIP, IRPQ, credit application and relevant documents, trade transactions and call reports, etc.

- Accept, confirm and execute clients’ investment orders, including but not limited to money market, securities, investment funds and FX transactions. Confirm with / advise clients on their order status in a timely manner. From time to time go through the selling process, suitability check, key economic factors and main risk factors of certain products with clients when needed.

- Liaises and coordinates with Credit Department to ensure all clients’ credit applications are properly processed.

- Attends internal / external trainings / meetings when possible and required. Ensuring fit and proper requirements (such as CPT requirement, AML training, fraud training and compliance certification etc.) as stipulated by the regulatory are completely met.

- General ad-hoc duties such as to perform routine follow up and administration work.

- Assists to ad-hoc IT projects on enhancement or upgrade of current IT systems if required

- Back up other Assistant Relationship Managers as and when required.

## Qualifications

- University graduate

- Preferably with 2-3 years of private banking experience

- Fluent in English, Cantonese and Mandarin

- Professional qualifications such as Enhanced Competency Framework (ECF) would be an advantage.

- The employment is subject to Mandatory Reference Checking Scheme (MRCS) as per regulatory requirement. For details, please refer to Hong Kong Monetary Authority - Mandatory Reference Checking Scheme

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Key Responsibilities

- Receive, prepare and initiate the execution of customer’s instructions complying with internal procedures (authorizations, establishment of internal forms, collecting of internal signatures if required, transmitting the instructions to the relevant department).

- Manage investment instructions received by the Clients.

- Collect customer’s instructions in case of corporate action events.

- Follow-up on the accuracy and the completeness of the customers files.

- Follow-up on pending issues and escalate to the Customer Relationship Officer (CRO) if necessary.

- Be the contact person on behalf of the team for the other departments of the bank whenever needed (troubleshooting, requests, etc.).

- Be the alternative contact person to the Client Relationship Officer for customers (phone answering, meetings, etc.).

- Perform research work upon CRO’s request.

- Prepare any documental support on behalf of the CRO.

- Assist the CRO in any other delegated tasks.

- Monitor Credit on a daily or monthly basis (limit excess review, collateral excess review, overdrafts, risk concentration, significant loss, etc.).

- Monitor Operation quality on a daily basis (deposit renewal, pending orders, MiFID profile, negative cash balance check, etc.).

- Monitor Risk on a yearly basis (dormant accounts, hold mail account, small balance accounts, claims escalation and follow up on a case by case basis, etc.).

## Skills and experience

## Experience: Minimum of 3 years in a similar role within private banking or financial services.

Knowledge: Strong understanding of private banking processes, financial products, and regulatory requirements (KYC, AML, FATCA, CRS).

Languages: Excellent proficiency in French and, English, Italian is considered as asset.

Technical Skills: Proficient in standard IT systems; ability to quickly learn new software.

Personal Attributes

- Service-oriented and client-focused mindset

- Strong team player with a collaborative spirit

- High level of confidentiality and discretion

- Proactive and self-motivated

- Detail-oriented, accurate, and reliable

- Open-minded and eager to learn new skills

Our Values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement.

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results.

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence.

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset.

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

- Gestire le istruzioni di investimento ricevute dai Clienti.
- Raccogliere le istruzioni del cliente in caso di eventi di azione aziendale.
- Seguire l'accuratezza e la completezza dei file dei clienti. - follow-up su questioni in sospeso ed escalate al Customer Relationship Officer (CRO) se necessario.
- No. Essere la persona di contatto per conto del team per gli altri dipartimenti della banca ogni volta che necessario (risoluzione dei problemi, richieste, ecc.)
- Siate la persona di contatto alternativa al Responsabile relazioni cliente per i clienti (risposte telefoniche, riunioni, ecc.).
- Eseguire i lavori di ricerca su richiesta del CRO.
- Preparare qualsiasi supporto documentale a nome del CRO.
- Assistere il CRO in qualsiasi altro compito delegato.

- Giocatore di squadra forte con uno spirito collaborativo
- Alto livello di riservatezza e discrezione
- Proattivo e auto-motivato
- Dettaglio orientato, accurato e affidabile
- Aperto e desideroso di imparare nuove competenze I nostri valori
- Contabilità: Prendere la proprietà per compiti e sfide, così come la ricerca di miglioramento continuo.
- Hands-on: essere proattivi per fornire rapidamente risultati di alta qualità.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Job Description

The role requires you to support the Director and Senior Managers in the efficient and effective functioning of the team, providing day to day support and contributing to the effective execution of team objectives, whilst developing the skills necessary for future progression into full managerial responsibilities.

Working closely with senior leadership and cross functional teams, you will help to ensure that processes run smoothly, compliance standards are met, and service levels are maintained.

This role supports continuous improvement initiatives, assists in managing workloads and priorities, and contributes to the delivery of high-quality services that enable the business to operate efficiently and effectively.

## Main Responsibilities

- Perform your role in accordance with established procedures, taking the lead on day-to-day activities and assuming ownership for compliance and fund governance aspects of the services provided to clients, with limited supervision.

- Conduct compliance testing and monitoring as part of the Compliance Monitoring Programmes for regulated fund structures, ensuring all findings are addressed and documented.

- Prepare six-monthly compliance reports for client entities, presenting key findings and updates for board meetings.

- Oversee the client periodic review process for Funds Services, including monitoring and clearing external audit points raised for fund clients.

- Develop, maintain, and enhance systems, controls, policies, and procedures to ensure adherence to Group directives, regulatory requirements, and evolving industry standards.

- Demonstrate a solid understanding of different regulated fund types and the governance requirements associated with each, supporting the team in delivering high-quality service.

- Proactively manage operational and fiduciary risks, independently organising and prioritising tasks to ensure timely and effective service delivery.

- Supervise and support junior colleagues, monitoring workflow, delegating tasks, and acting as a point of escalation for compliance-related queries.

- Contribute to projects and change initiatives, continually identifying opportunities for improvement, standardisation, and increased efficiency in fund governance and compliance processes.

- Maintain compliance with all relevant laws, regulations, codes of practice, and internal policies; assess and escalate risks to management as appropriate.

- Take responsibility for your own professional development, ensuring all CPD and relevant training requirements are met annually.

## Skills and experience

- Recognised Professional Qualification - e.g. Accountancy, Chartered Secretary, STEP, Banking, Securities, Compliance or other relevant Table 5 qualification (working towards Table 5) along with relevant experience in AML/CFT/CPF and Financial Regulation.

- 3 years' relevant finance industry experience working within an offshore financial services organisation, with a good understanding of all areas of client administration and fiduciary services.

- A good knowledge and understanding of the local finance industry, legislation and regulatory requirements in the environment in which we operate.

- Possess a strong commitment to client service excellence

- Ability to manage workloads effectively whilst navigating varying deadlines.

- Ability to work accurately under pressure, with minimum supervision and communicate with clarity and purpose both in written and verbal forms.

- Strong interpersonal skills are essential.

- Proficient in the use of a range of Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint).  Knowledge of PureClient, FrontInvest and/or Navision is desirable.

## Our Values

-  Accountability : Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

-  Hands-on : Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

-  Passionate : Being committed and striving for excellence

-  Solution-driven : Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

-  Partnership-oriented : Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Questo ruolo supporta iniziative di miglioramento continuo, assiste nella gestione dei carichi di lavoro e delle priorità, e contribuisce alla fornitura di servizi di alta qualità che permettono al business di operare in modo efficiente ed efficace.

- Proficiente nell'uso di una gamma di prodotti Microsoft (Outlook, Word, Excel e PowerPoint). La conoscenza di PureClient, FrontInvest e/o Navision è auspicabile.

## Our Values
- Accountability: Assumere la proprietà per i compiti e le sfide, nonché cercare un miglioramento continuo

- Passionate: Essere impegnati e impegnati per l'eccellenza

Description de l'emploi Le rôle exige que vous souteniez le directeur et les cadres supérieurs dans le fonctionnement efficace et efficient de l'équipe, en leur fournissant un soutien quotidien et en contribuant à l'exécution efficace des objectifs de l'équipe, tout en développant les compétences nécessaires à la progression future vers des responsabilités de gestion complètes. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les cadres supérieurs et les équipes interfonctionnelles, vous vous assurerez que les processus fonctionnent bien, que les normes de conformité sont respectées et que les niveaux de service sont maintenus. Ce rôle appuie les initiatives d'amélioration continue, aide à gérer la charge de travail et les priorités et contribue à la prestation de services de haute qualité qui permettent à l'entreprise de fonctionner efficacement.

## Principales responsabilités
- Exécutez votre rôle conformément aux procédures établies, dirigez les activités quotidiennes et assumez la propriété des aspects de la conformité et de la gouvernance des services fournis aux clients, avec une supervision limitée.
- Effectuer des essais et des contrôles de conformité dans le cadre des programmes de surveillance de la conformité pour les structures de fonds réglementées, en veillant à ce que toutes les constatations soient prises en compte et documentées.
- Préparer des rapports semestriels sur la conformité pour les entités clientes, en présentant les principales constatations et mises à jour pour les réunions du conseil.
- Superviser le processus d'examen périodique des clients pour les services des fonds, y compris le suivi et l'élimination des points d'audit externe recueillis pour les clients des fonds.
- Élaborer, maintenir et améliorer les systèmes, les contrôles, les politiques et les procédures pour assurer le respect des directives du groupe, des exigences réglementaires et de l'évolution des normes de l'industrie.
- Démontrer une bonne compréhension des différents types de fonds réglementés et des exigences de gouvernance associées à chacun, en aidant l'équipe à fournir des services de haute qualité.
- Gérer de manière proactive les risques opérationnels et fiduciaires, organiser et hiérarchiser les tâches de manière indépendante afin d'assurer une prestation de services rapide et efficace.

- Contribuer aux projets et aux initiatives de changement, identifier en permanence les possibilités d'amélioration, de normalisation et d'efficacité accrue dans les processus de gouvernance et de conformité des fonds.
- Maintenir le respect de toutes les lois, règlements, codes de pratique et politiques internes pertinents; évaluer et accroître les risques pour la gestion, le cas échéant.
- Oui. Prenez la responsabilité de votre propre perfectionnement professionnel, en veillant à ce que toutes les exigences en matière de DPC et de formation soient respectées chaque année.

## Compétences et expérience
- Qualification professionnelle reconnue - p. ex. comptabilité, secrétaire agréé, STEP, banques, valeurs mobilières, conformité ou autre qualification pertinente du tableau 5 (travaillant vers le tableau 5), ainsi que l'expérience pertinente en matière de LMA/FT/PFC et de réglementation financière. - 3 ans d'expérience pertinente de l'industrie financière travaillant au sein d'une organisation de services financiers offshore, avec une bonne compréhension de tous les domaines de l'administration client et des services fiduciaires.
- Une bonne connaissance et une bonne compréhension de l'industrie financière locale, de la législation et des exigences réglementaires dans l'environnement dans lequel nous opérons.
- Avoir un engagement ferme envers l'excellence du service à la clientèle
- Capacité de gérer efficacement la charge de travail tout en naviguant dans des délais variables.
- Capacité de travailler avec précision sous pression, avec une supervision minimale et de communiquer avec clarté et finalité, tant par écrit que verbalement.
- De fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles sont essentielles.
- Compétence dans l'utilisation d'une gamme de produits Microsoft (Outlook, Word, Excel et PowerPoint). La connaissance de PureClient, FrontInvest et/ou Navision est souhaitable.

- Passionné : S'engager et s'efforcer d'atteindre l'excellence

- According to the regulatory requirements and internal policies, perform CDD/KYC review on Client Profile, SOW plausibility, transactions review and screenings for client onboarding. periodic review and triggered review.

- Ensure that the CDD information (covering documents, account structure, PEP status, adverse news, system data, tax related papers, etc) obtained during the CDD process up-to-date and relevant.

- Identify and assess any risk during review and escalate to compliance if necessary.

- Follow ups with CRO/CSO to request for supplementary documentation and ensure timely completion of Account Opening, Periodic Review and Triggered Reviews.

- Acting as Case manager, tracking and reporting the status of Account Opening/Periodic Review and Triggered Reviews to Head of PBS.

- Facilitate the case discussions with Front Office and compliance.

- Participates in and contributes to ad hoc initiatives as well as special projects

## Qualification Requirements

•    Bachelor degree or above in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or related field;

 •    Sound knowledge in AML / KYC risks with at least 5-6 years relevant experience, preferable in Private Banking;

 •    Demonstrated ability to multitask and work with minimal supervision, adapt and adjust to changing work priorities.

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile delle relazioni con i clienti

descriptionByLocale.en:
Main Duties & Responsibilities
- Risk Management and Compliance:
- Adherence to laws and regulations, internal risk and compliance policies and the Group Code of Conduct.
- Completion of all mandatory risk and compliance training including e-learning within stated timeframe.
- Proactive identification of risks and concerns, including escalation to all relevant stakeholders.
- Timely mitigation of risks and resolution of issues including collaboration with all relevant stakeholder functions and establishment of effective controls.
- Introduces the Bank and its banking services to prospective clients.
- Supports the expected goal of business performance set forth by the management.
- Markets and provides private banking services to clients including but not limited to banking services, investment services, wealth planning and trust, etc.
- Performs KYC / AML due diligence on clients in compliance with the Bank’s general directive during the course of account opening process and ongoing periodic review from time to time.
- Goes through the Investment Risk Profile Questionnaire with clients at time of account opening as well as performs ongoing periodic review to ensure clients’ investment product suitability, risk tolerant and investment experience from time to time.
- Liaises and coordinates with the Bank’s investment units, e.g. Treasury Department, EFG Asset Management, Global Product Unit for passing on product information and market commentary to clients from time to time.
- Closely monitors clients’ portfolio and account activities to ensure the compliance with internal guidelines as well as external regulations from time to time. Monitors clients’ position to ensure client acknowledge the MTM loss if over 20% of portfolio or USD500,000, collateral sufficiency at all times and prompt regularization of excesses, if any.
- Prepares and maintains proper records including but not limited to account documentation, CIP, credit application and relevant documents, trade transactions and call reports, etc.
- Responsibly and effectively manages business expenses.

Qualifications Requirements
- Licenses: Type 1 and Type 4.
- Certificate – CPWP.
- University degree or equivalent

Professional qualifications such as Enhanced Competency Framework (ECF) would be an advantage.

The employment is subject to Mandatory Reference Checking Scheme (MRCS) as per regulatory requirement. For details, please refer to Hong Kong Monetary Authority
- Mandatory Reference Checking Scheme

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del rischio aziendale - PB COO

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain a comprehensive risk and control assessment for all aspects of risk within the FLoD, including effective oversight of the testing programme.

- Execute   a risk-based control monitoring programme   across the function, evidencing the adequacy and effectiveness of key controls.

- Perform regular business controls and monitoring on areas such as Investment Suitability, Cross Border, Anti-Fraud, etc., including management reporting and proactive recommendations.

- Conduct thematic reviews, investigations and gap analyses across FLoD activities.

- Participate in and/or lead projects and change initiatives to implement process and control enhancements.

- Promote a strong risk awareness and client fairness culture across the business.

- Collaborate closely with Second Line of Defense, Global Functions and other internal stakeholders to identify, assess and mitigate risks and ensure appropriate controls are in place.

- Proactively escalate and report issues, provide advice and challenge existing processes related to business activities.

- Manage the FLoD Risk Scorecard, ensuring proper tracking, execution and data integrity.

- Provide professional advice to front office staff on investment advisory activities to ensure compliance with internal policies, procedures and local regulatory requirements.

- Build strong relationships and credibility with key internal stakeholders.

- Provide guidance to junior team members and new joiners,  and act as a checker to ensure quality and accuracy of reviews.

- Undertake any other duties within Business Risk Management as directed by the Head of Business Risk Management

## Role Requirement

-  5+ years and solid business risk management experience in private banking / wealth management.

-  Strong analytical skills, sound judgement and a high level of integrity and rule compliance.

-  Ability to work independently, challenge the status quo and build strong stakeholder relationships

descriptionByLocale.en:
General Info

- Department: Data Ops Engineer

- Work time Percentage: 100%

- Location: Singapore

Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

Job Description

## Introduction to the Team

- DataOps Team is responsible for seemless integration, release and monitoring of mission critical data pipelines and workflows

- Currently based in Geneva, we are expanding our global footprint by establishing a virtual team presence in Singapore.

- Reporting to the local IT Head of Applications, the role will be a key pillar in our follow-the-sun support model, ensuring continuous operational excellence across Asia and Europe timezone.

- Our data platform is evolving into a more converged stack, unifying data streams and batches. We are expanding into a cloud based lakehouse and a microservice based data streaming integration model supporting business critical integrations

- To support team activity Python, SQL and CI/CD are essentialskills. This role requires a rigorous approach to documentation and procedure development.

- The team is responsible for building, testing, deploying and monitor the operating part of the platform.

Tasks and Responsibilities

- Take operational ownership of specific data services (change management, quality assurance, SLA, SOP)

- Track and ensure operations continuity of critical data pipelines across the group during Asian hours, adopting a follow-the sun support model.

- Design, implement, and optimize data pipeline in batch and streaming mode.

- Follow and apply CI/CD practice to automate and streamline deployments and integrations.

- Create, maintain, improve documentation and operational procedures as part of operational ownership

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to review governance and improve integration operations.

- Maintain high standards of data quality, reliability, and performance.

- Stay current with advancements in data engineering, of dataops tech stack, to support continuous improvement.

Requirements and Qualifications

- Experience in data engineering and data operations roles.

- Proven hands-on experience with SQL, Python, PySpark and Databricks

- Knowledge of micro-services architecture, API management and observability is highly desirable.

- Solid understanding of CI/CD platforms and processes (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitLabCI, GitHub Actions).

- Experience with cloud data platforms (Azure preferred).

- Demonstrated ability to produce rigorous, clear, and comprehensive documentation and procedures.

- Familiarity with database design.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- Effective communication and collaboration skills.

Personal Attributes

- Responsible and reliable, especially during critical operational periods

- Rigorous and methodical in documentation and process creation

- Motivated and goal-oriented

- Curious, enthusiastic, creative, and proactive

- Passionate about analytics and technology, with a strong desire to learn and grow

- Fluent in spoken and written English

Our Values

Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

Application

Should you wish to apply for this position use this link to apply.

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile della sicurezza delle informazioni e BCM (Asia)

descriptionByLocale.en:
General Info
- Department: Global CISO
- Work time Percentage: 100%
- Location: Singapore ideally or Hong-Kong

Our Company
EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

Our Purpose and Mission
Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

Job Description
EFG’s Information Security and BCM team, led by the Group CISO, sets and coordinates global information security strategy, initiatives, and standards across EFG International. The team conducts security risk assessments, manages vulnerability and threat programs, and owns security awareness and training. It safeguards EFG’s infrastructure, applications, and data against breaches, malware, third‑party risks, and cyber-attacks. Additionally, it strengthens the bank’s defence through robust Business Continuity Management, supporting operational resilience and coordinated incident response

Provide regional leadership on information security across SG and HK; serve as the Singapore and Hong Kong Information Security Officer.

Identify, evaluate, and manage regional information security risks and vulnerabilities; ensure preventative actions close risk gaps.

Conduct regular security assessments and audits to ensure compliance with internal, regulatory, and industry requirements; ensure timely closure of audit items.

Collaborate on Operational Resilience and Business Continuity (BCP); act as local BCM referant ensuring internal and external requirements (e.g., HKMA OR-2) are met.

Review data security breaches, implement remediation, and design and lead the annual cyber-security incident drill for SG & HK.

-
Collaborate with Group Information Security to deploy monitoring tools safeguarding bank information.

-
Oversee timely completion of local and regional user access recertifications.

-
Approve and periodically review privileged access for business and IT users; recertify IT administrator and technical account access on locally and regionally managed infrastructure.

-
Serve as gatekeeper for data extraction from secure zones.

Stakeholder engagement, communications, and training

-
Build and maintain relationships with stakeholders, clients, leadership, regulators, and Head Office teams.

-
Monitor and manage security communications from Head Office and regulators.

-
Lead security awareness and training programs for employees and relevant stakeholders.

-
Support assessments for infrastructure and applications; perform periodic security reviews and audits.

-
Recommend enhancements to controls and processes based on emerging threats and best practices.

Reporting, budgeting, and resource management

-
Report timely status of projects, programs, risks, events, and incidents to the Group CISO.

-
Prepare spending proposals; manage local security budgets and resources effectively.

- 10+ years in information security with strong knowledge of security principles, practices, and technologies.
- Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise security programs.
- Hands-on incident management and incident response expertise.
- Demonstrated leadership, including managing and influencing virtual/remote teams.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Main Responsibilities

- Enhance daily collaboration with Client Relationship Officers and serve as a central competence hub

- Coordinate priority Wealth Planning initiatives, including the enhancement of core offerings and development of new solutions

- Enhance structured reporting frameworks to monitor execution progress, measure impact, and support management steering and reporting for the Global head of Wealth Planning

- Support development of targeted Wealth Planning content defined by Global Head of Wealth Planning and client engagement tools to elevate market positioning (e.g. client events, white papers, thematic campaigns)

- Support Global Head of Wealth Planning on ad hoc projects/cost management processes etc/ MTP

## Skills and experience

- University degree in Business Administration or Finance related discipline;

- Minimum 5 years of experience and a demonstrated track record of business management, project management and or strategy consulting.

- Methodical thinker with a proven ability to demonstrate exceptional analytical rigor

- Strong organisational skills, structured approach, strict adherence to legal, regulatory and compliance requirements.

- Practical experience in creating client-ready proposals and presentations using the suite of Microsoft applications.

- Languages: excellent command of English is required; German, French or Italian would be an advantage.

## Our Values

-  Accountability : Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

-  Hands-on : Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

-  Passionate : Being committed and striving for excellence

-  Solution-driven : Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

-  Partnership-oriented : Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

- Laurea in amministrazione aziendale o disciplina affine alla finanza;

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Job Description

We’re hiring a senior FX Specialist in Zurich to develop and deliver a strong FX advisory capability for our private banking clients.

This is a newly created role, focused on building relationships with CROs (Client Relationship Officers) and engaging clients with relevant and timely FX solutions.

If you are expert and experienced in FX markets, with extensive proficiency in all FX tools,  comfortable working independently, and motivated by the chance to shape something from the ground up — this could be the right next step in your career.

## Roles responsibilities

- As subject matter expert the resource will engage directly with private banking clients and work alongside CROs to deliver tailored FX advice and solutions.

- Manage highly divergent audience at an high level of complexity

- Complement the efforts of CROs by bringing extensive market expertise and product knowledge to client conversations.

- Offer tailored solutions across the full range of FX products, aligned with client objectives, risk profiles, and prevailing market conditions.

- Take ownership of the full trade lifecycle: you will anticipate business needs and offer unique solutions - from opportunity identification to post-trade support.

- Monitor macroeconomic and market developments and translate insights into actionable advice.

- Be the key enablers in expanding FX advisory within the Switzerland booking center and strengthening internal awareness of the offering.

- Being accountable for delivery of tactical business targets that are financially measurable and discipline‑level impact as a norm .

Why EFG, Why This Role?

- New role, clear focus: the resource will have space to define and develop this function , with the backing of a strong platform.

- High visibility: work directly with CROs and senior leaders across the business. You will be the subject matter expert managing diverse and senior stakeholders internally and externally to convey complex information.

- Environment: Agile, international, and client-focused, without unnecessary layers.

## Skills and Experience

- 15 years of experience in FX advisory in a private banking or wealth management environment.

- Deep knowledge of FX markets and macroeconomic trends.

- Comfortable interacting with clients and CROs in a thoughtful, clear, and solution-oriented way.

- Independent and autonomous in seeking opportunities and acts on them.

- Strong attention to detail, especially around execution and follow-up.

- Fluency in English required; German or French or Italian language is considered as a plus.

## Our Values

-  Accountability : Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

-  Hands-on : Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

-  Passionate : Being committed and striving for excellence

-  Solution-driven : Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

-  Partnership-oriented : Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.
descriptionByLocale.it:

## Introduction of the team

- At EFG we want to create value fom data. Within our Data Office department, we’re seeking a highly skilled and motivated AI Software Engineer to join our Machine Learning & GenAI team. You will embark on building a new, scalable AI platform and design, build, and deploy AI-driven systems that deliver measurable business impact.

- This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact in a growing organization committed to delivering an outstanding digital banking experience for our clients.

Main responsibilities

-  1) Platform and Architecture

- Design and build a hybrid (on-prem / on-cloud) AI/ML platform to run AI use cases at scale (feature stores, model registry, experimentation, evaluation, observability).

- Define and implement secure, reliable inference and training architectures, including vector search and RAG components where applicable.

- Provide platform support for embeddings, vector databases, and AI agentic communication protocols to enable grounded, interoperable AI workflows.

- Document machine learning processes, system architecture, and operational runbooks for reproducibility and knowledge sharing.

-  2) Model Development & Evaluation

- Collaborate on training, fine-tuning, and optimizing models (LLMs, NLP, recommendations), including LoRA/PEFT when relevant.

- Implement guardrails and prompt strategies to reduce hallucinations and improve safety and consistency, and support agentic workflows.

- Establish evaluation frameworks for RAG and LLM systems.

-  3) Software Development & MLOps

- Own end-to-end software development of AI services and APIs (from design and coding to testing and deployment).

- Automate build, test, and deployment using CI/CD pipelines; manage model/version releases via model registries.

- Implement continuous monitoring for deployed AI systems.

-  4) Product & Stakeholder Collaboration

- Work closely with Business Users, Product Owners, Business Engineers, Data Managers, Data Scientists, and technology teams to understand AI/ML use cases, requirements, and success metrics.

- Partner with Data Scientists to iterate on prototypes and convert them into robust, scalable production services.

- Translate emerging GenAI/Agentic AI capabilities into actionable product opportunities and reusable components for the Bank.

-  5) Security, Privacy, and Compliance

- Ensure all AI/ML solutions meet bank-wide data and AI guidelines and standards, including data protection, cyber security, and responsible AI practices.

- Embed privacy-by-design, access controls, encryption, and auditability across data flows and model operations.

- Collaborate with Risk, Security, and Compliance to align with SOC 2, GDPR/CCPA, and internal governance.

## Skills and experience

## 1) Education

- Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or related.

## 2) Must-Have

- Extensive knowledge of ML/AI frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow; Hugging Face ecosystem; LangChain/LlamaIndex or equivalent for orchestration, data structures, data modeling, and software architecture.

- Practical LLM experience: prompt engineering, fine-tuning/LoRA, embeddings, vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate), RAG patterns.

- Solid programming skills in Python, R or Java/Scala, hands on experience in SQL, ETL tool and Linux and Control-M & Terraform knowledge are a plus.

- Prior experience deploying applications on cloud environments (Azure); familiarity with hybrid on‑prem/cloud setups.

- Experience building production-grade services and APIs (REST/gRPC), cloud-native (AWS/GCP/Azure), containers (Docker), and orchestration (Openshift, Kubernetes).

- MLOps foundations: experiment tracking (MLflow/W&B), model registries, CI/CD, model monitoring, feature stores.

- Ability to monitor, debug, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that feed into production deployments (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Azure DevOps).

- Data engineering proficiency: SQL, data modeling, ETL/ELT, and working with warehouses/lakes (Snowflake, BigQuery, S3/Delta).

- Ability to work in a SCRUM/Agile environment with a focus on delivery and stakeholder collaboration.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities; results- and detail-oriented with strong written and verbal communication.

- Experience in the Banking Or Wealth Management Industry is an advantage

## 3) Nice-to-Have

- Experience deploying and optimizing open-source models (Llama, Mistral, Mixtral) on GPUs; quantization (INT8/4), tensor/Flash attention.

- Knowledge of retrieval systems (BM25, hybrid search), semantic caching, and structured tool use/agents.

- Evaluation expertise for LLMs: rubric-based grading, golden sets, adversarial testing, and A/B experimentation.

- Security practices for AI applications: prompt injection defenses, output filtering, content moderation, and red-teaming.

- Contributions to open-source AI projects or published work.

Our Values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

-  Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

## Application

- Should you wish to apply for this position use this link to apply.
